fieldLabelListedSource_title: Form fields have a label from a source RGAA lists
fieldLabelListedSource_description: Checks that each form field has an aria-labelledby, an aria-label, a <label for> or a title, the label sources RGAA 11.1.1 lists.
fieldLabelListedSource_summary_fail_noLa: This form field has no aria-labelledby, aria-label, <label for> or title.
fieldLabelListedSource_hint_fail_noLabel: Give the field a <label for> that matches its id, or an aria-labelledby, aria-label or title attribute.
fieldLabelListedSource_summary_fail_plac: This form field is labelled only by its placeholder, which RGAA does not accept as a label.
fieldLabelListedSource_hint_fail_placeho: Give the field a <label for> that matches its id, or an aria-labelledby, aria-label or title attribute. A placeholder disappears as soon as the user types.
fieldLabelListedSource_summary_fail_cont: This form field is named only by its own content, which RGAA does not accept as a label.
fieldLabelListedSource_hint_fail_content: Give the field an aria-labelledby that points to the visible text, or an aria-label or title attribute.
fieldLabelListedSource_summary_cantTell_: This form field is labelled only by a <label> that wraps it, without a for attribute.
fieldLabelListedSource_hint_cantTell_wra: RGAA 11.1.1 names a <label> with a for attribute; check whether the audit accepts the wrapping label, or add for and a matching id.
fieldLabelListedSource_summary_cantTell_: A <label for> points at this field, but this element cannot be labelled by a <label>.
fieldLabelListedSource_hint_cantTell_lab: The label gives the field no accessible name. Use aria-labelledby pointing to the label text, or a native form field.
fieldLabelListedSource_summary_cantTell_: This form field has a {{source}} label source, but it is empty.
fieldLabelListedSource_hint_cantTell_emp: Check whether the field has a label; if not, put the label text in that source.
pageLanguagePresent_description: Checks that the page gives its default language with lang or xml:lang, on <html> or on an ancestor of every text.
pageLanguagePresent_summary_fail_missing: The page gives no default language: no element has a lang or xml:lang attribute.
pageLanguagePresent_summary_fail_uncover: Some text of the page has no language: neither <html> nor any of its parents has a lang or xml:lang attribute.
pageLanguagePresent_hint_fail: Add a lang attribute to the <html> element, for example <html lang="fr">.
pageLanguagePresent_summary_cantTell_xml: The page gives its language with xml:lang only, which this HTML version does not read.
pageLanguagePresent_hint_cantTell_xmlLan: Add lang with the same value, for example <html lang="fr" xml:lang="fr">.
htmlLangCodeValid_description: Checks that the language code of lang and xml:lang on <html> is a valid ISO 639 code.
htmlLangCodeValid_summary_fail: The page's default language is given as {{attribute}}="{{value}}", and "{{code}}" is not an ISO 639 language code.
htmlLangCodeValid_hint_fail: Start the value with the two- or three-letter ISO 639 code of the page's main language, for example "fr" or "fr-FR".
mediaTranscriptAdjacent_title: Audio and video have an adjacent transcript or a link to one
mediaTranscriptAdjacent_description: Checks that the element right before or right after each <audio> and <video> is a transcript, or a link or button to one, as RGAA 4.1 requires, and asks about media that have none.
mediaTranscriptAdjacent_summary_cantTell: No transcript, or link or button to one, is right before or after this <{{element}}>.
This <{{element}}> refers to a transcript through aria-describedby, but no transcript, or link or button to one, is right before or after it.
mediaTranscriptAdjacent_hint_cantTell: Check whether this media needs a transcript (RGAA 4.1). If it does, place the transcript, or a link or button to it, right before or right after the media, in the code and on screen. A video may instead have audio description.
pageTitleUnique_title: Page titles are unique across the site
pageTitleUnique_description: Compares the page title with the titles of the site’s other pages, given as the crawl.pageTitles probe, and fails one shared with another page, since RGAA 8.6.1 asks for a title that identifies the page uniquely.
pageTitleUnique_summary_fail_duplicate: Other pages of the site have the same title, "{{title}}": {{pages}}. RGAA asks that a page title identify the page « de manière claire, concise et unique ».
pageTitleUnique_hint_fail_duplicate: Give each page a title of its own that says what this page holds, for instance the page’s subject followed by the site’s name (RGAA 8.6.1).
pageTitleUnique_summary_cantTell_samePat: A page whose address differs from this one only by its query string has the same title, "{{title}}": {{pages}}.
pageTitleUnique_hint_cantTell_samePath: Check whether these addresses show different pages. If they do, give each its own title: RGAA asks that a page title identify the page « de manière claire, concise et unique » (RGAA 8.6.1).
pageTitleUnique_summary_cantTell_singleP: Only this page was available, so whether its title, "{{title}}", is unique across the site could not be checked.
pageTitleUnique_hint_cantTell_singlePage: Scan several pages of the site and pass their titles as the crawl.pageTitles probe, or check that no other page has this title: RGAA asks that a page title identify the page « de manière claire, concise et unique » (RGAA 8.6.1).
pageZonesReachable_title: Each area of the page can be reached or skipped
pageZonesReachable_description: Checks that the header, main navigation, main content, footer and search areas each have a landmark, and asks about an area found from its name that relies on a heading, a skip or quick-access link, or a button instead (RGAA 12.6.1).
pageZonesReachable_summary_cantTell_head: This area ("{{hint}}") has no landmark role. A heading opens it: check that the heading says what the area holds.
pageZonesReachable_summary_cantTell_skip: This area ("{{hint}}") has no landmark role. A same-page link just before it leads past it: check that it is a skip link for this area.
pageZonesReachable_summary_cantTell_togg: This area ("{{hint}}") has no landmark role. A button just before it may hide it: check that the button hides this area.
pageZonesReachable_summary_cantTell_quic: This area ("{{hint}}") has no landmark role. A same-page link leads to it: check that the link is visible, at least when it takes focus.
pageZonesReachable_summary_cantTell_none: This area ("{{hint}}") has no landmark role, no heading opening it, and no link or button to reach, skip or hide it.
pageZonesReachable_summary_cantTell_main: The page has no main landmark (<main> or role="main"), so how the main content can be reached could not be checked.
pageZonesReachable_hint_cantTell: An area already reachable by a heading that says what it holds, a skip or quick-access link, or a button that hides it meets RGAA 12.6.1 as it is. Otherwise give it the landmark that matches it: <header>, <nav>, <main>, <footer>, or role="search" on the search form.
contrastMinimumRgaa_title: Text meets RGAA minimum color contrast
contrastMinimumRgaa_description: Checks that visible text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, or 3:1 for text of 24px or more and bold text of 18.5px or more (RGAA 3.2), when contrast is computable from CSS.
contrastMinimumRgaa_fail_belowThreshold: Element has insufficient color contrast of {{ratio}}:1 (foreground: {{foregroundHex}}, background: {{backgroundHex}}, font size: {{fontSizePx}}px, font weight: {{fontWeightLabel}}). Expected contrast ratio of {{threshold}}:1 ({{#isLargeText}}text of 24px or more, or bold text of 18.5px or more{{/isLargeText}}{{^isLargeText}}text below 24px, or bold text below 18.5px{{/isLargeText}}).
contrastMinimumRgaa_hint_fail: Change the text color, the background color, or both, so the contrast ratio reaches at least {{threshold}}:1.
contrastMinimumRgaa_pass_allAboveThresho: All computable text meets the RGAA 3.2 contrast threshold. Eligible text nodes: {{eligibleTextCount}}. Computable: {{computableTextCount}}.
contrastMinimumRgaa_notApplicable_noComp: No eligible text had computable contrast (eligible text nodes: {{eligibleTextCount}}). See the contrast computability rule for details.
contrastMinimumRgaa_cantTell_engineFailu: The RGAA 3.2 contrast could not be determined due to an internal engine error ({{reasonCode}}).
focusIndicatorContrast_title: Author focus indicators have a contrast ratio of at least 3:1
focusIndicatorContrast_description: Checks that an outline, border or box-shadow drawn by a :focus or :focus-visible rule in place of the browser outline has a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 with the colors next to it, and asks when it cannot be computed.
focusIndicatorContrast_summary_fail_lowC: The {{property}} this element shows on focus ({{color}}) has a contrast ratio of {{ratio}}:1 with the colors next to it, below 3:1.
focusIndicatorContrast_hint_fail_lowCont: Give the focus indicator a color with a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against the background behind the element and against the element itself (RGAA 10.7.1).
focusIndicatorContrast_summary_cantTell_: The {{property}} this element shows on focus ({{color}}) reaches 3:1 against only one of the colors next to it ({{ratio}}:1 against the other).
focusIndicatorContrast_hint_cantTell_one: Check on the page that the focus indicator is clearly visible, with a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 (RGAA 10.7.1).
focusIndicatorContrast_summary_cantTell_: The contrast of this element's focus indicator could not be computed (a background image, a gradient, a blurred shadow, an animation, a CSS variable, a condition such as @media, or rules the engine cannot order).
focusIndicatorContrast_hint_cantTell_not: Measure the contrast of the focus indicator on the page: it needs a ratio of at least 3:1 with the colors next to it (RGAA 10.7.1).
focusIndicatorContrast_summary_cantTell_: This element's focus style changes something the engine does not measure (background, text color, underline, or another element).
focusIndicatorContrast_hint_cantTell_not: Check on the page that the focus style is visible, with a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 (RGAA 10.7.1).
linkContentLabelPresent_title: Links have a label in their content
linkContentLabelPresent_description: Checks that each link holds text or an image with a text alternative, rather than being named only by aria-label, aria-labelledby or title.
linkContentLabelPresent_summary_fail_noL: This link has no text or image text alternative in its content.
linkContentLabelPresent_summary_fail_nam: This link has no text or image text alternative in its content; its name comes only from {{source}}.
linkContentLabelPresent_hint_fail: Put the link text inside the link, or an image with a text alternative. A name given only by aria-label, aria-labelledby or title does not count for RGAA 6.2.
linkContentLabelPresent_summary_cantTell: This link has content but no text or image text alternative that assistive technologies read: hidden text, CSS-generated text, an embedded element, or an element named by aria-label.
linkContentLabelPresent_hint_cantTell_co: Check whether the link content gives it a label. Put the link text inside the link, or give its image a text alternative.
formButtonNamePresent_title: Buttons in a form have a label
formButtonNamePresent_description: Checks that each button inside a form (a <form> or role="form") has a label that RGAA 11.9.1 can judge.
formButtonNamePresent_summary_fail_nameM: This button in a form has no label.
formButtonNamePresent_hint_fail_nameMiss: Give the button visible text that describes its action, or an aria-label, aria-labelledby or title; for an image button, an alt.
formButtonNamePresent_summary_cantTell_i: This image button in a form has no alt, aria-label, aria-labelledby or title; the browser names it with a generic "Submit".
formButtonNamePresent_hint_cantTell_imag: Give the image button an alt that describes its action, then check that the label is relevant.
formButtonNamePresent_summary_cantTell_f: This button has no label and sits outside the form it submits, which it joins through its form attribute.
formButtonNamePresent_hint_cantTell_form: Check whether the audit counts this button as part of the form. In any case, give it a label that describes its action.
linkLabelInNameSources_title: Every name source of a link contains its visible label
linkLabelInNameSources_description: Checks that the title, aria-label and aria-labelledby of a link with a visible label each contain that label, as RGAA 6.1.5 requires.
linkLabelInNameSources_summary_fail_name: {{element}}: the accessible name of this link (from {{sources}}) does not contain its visible label "{{visibleLabel}}".
linkLabelInNameSources_hint_fail_name: Make the attribute that names the element contain the visible label, ideally at its start, or remove it so the visible text names the element.
linkLabelInNameSources_summary_fail_sour: {{element}}: the {{sources}} of this link does not contain its visible label "{{visibleLabel}}".
linkLabelInNameSources_hint_fail_source: RGAA checks every source present, not only the one that gives the accessible name. Make each of them contain the visible label, or remove the ones that do not.
linkLabelInNameSources_summary_cantTell_: {{element}}: the visible label "{{visibleLabel}}" of this link may be a symbol, and the {{sources}} does not contain it.
linkLabelInNameSources_hint_cantTell_sym: If the visible text is a symbol (an icon glyph, "X" for close, ">" for next), check that the name says what the symbol means. If it is literal text, the name must contain it.
linkLabelInNameSources_summary_cantTell_: {{element}}: the {{sources}} of this link differs from its visible label "{{visibleLabel}}" only by an abbreviation or by text in parentheses.
linkLabelInNameSources_hint_cantTell_nea: Check whether the source still contains the visible label as a user would say it. RGAA excuses only punctuation and capital letters.
fieldLabelInNameSources_title: Every label source of a form field contains its visible label
fieldLabelInNameSources_description: Checks that the aria-label, aria-labelledby, title and <label> of a form field with a visible label each contain that label, as RGAA 11.2.5 requires.
fieldLabelInNameSources_summary_fail_nam: {{element}}: the accessible name of this form field (from {{sources}}) does not contain its visible label "{{visibleLabel}}".
fieldLabelInNameSources_hint_fail_name: Make the attribute that names the element contain the visible label, ideally at its start, or remove it so the visible text names the element.
fieldLabelInNameSources_summary_fail_sou: {{element}}: the {{sources}} of this form field does not contain its visible label "{{visibleLabel}}".
fieldLabelInNameSources_hint_fail_source: RGAA checks every source present, not only the one that gives the accessible name. Make each of them contain the visible label, or remove the ones that do not.
fieldLabelInNameSources_summary_cantTell: {{element}}: the visible label "{{visibleLabel}}" of this form field may be a symbol, and the {{sources}} does not contain it.
fieldLabelInNameSources_hint_cantTell_sy: If the visible text is a symbol (an icon glyph, "X" for close, ">" for next), check that the name says what the symbol means. If it is literal text, the name must contain it.
fieldLabelInNameSources_summary_cantTell: {{element}}: the {{sources}} of this form field differs from its visible label "{{visibleLabel}}" only by an abbreviation or by text in parentheses.
fieldLabelInNameSources_hint_cantTell_ne: Check whether the source still contains the visible label as a user would say it. RGAA excuses only punctuation and capital letters.
formButtonLabelInNameSources_title: The accessible name of a button in a form contains its visible label
formButtonLabelInNameSources_description: Checks that each button inside a form (a <form> or role="form") has an accessible name that contains its visible label, as RGAA 11.9.2 requires, and asks about other label sources that do not.
formButtonLabelInNameSources_summary_fai: {{element}}: the accessible name of this button (from {{sources}}) does not contain its visible label "{{visibleLabel}}".
formButtonLabelInNameSources_hint_fail_n: Make the attribute that names the element contain the visible label, ideally at its start, or remove it so the visible text names the element.
formButtonLabelInNameSources_summary_can: {{element}}: the {{sources}} of this button does not contain its visible label "{{visibleLabel}}", but does not give the button its accessible name.
formButtonLabelInNameSources_hint_cantTe: RGAA 11.9.2 lists every source in its conditions, but its methodology checks only the accessible name. Check which reading the audit follows. Making the attribute contain the visible label, or removing it, settles both.
formButtonLabelInNameSources_summary_can: {{element}}: the visible label "{{visibleLabel}}" of this button may be a symbol, and the {{sources}} does not contain it.
formButtonLabelInNameSources_hint_cantTe: If the visible text is a symbol (an icon glyph, "X" for close, ">" for next), check that the name says what the symbol means. If it is literal text, the name must contain it.
formButtonLabelInNameSources_summary_can: {{element}}: the {{sources}} of this button differs from its visible label "{{visibleLabel}}" only by an abbreviation or by text in parentheses.
formButtonLabelInNameSources_hint_cantTe: Check whether the source still contains the visible label as a user would say it. RGAA excuses only punctuation and capital letters.
widgetLabelInName_title: The accessible name of a scripted component contains its visible label
widgetLabelInName_description: Checks that an element with an ARIA widget role (tab, menu item, tree item, grid cell, option) has an accessible name that contains its visible label, as RGAA 7.1.3 requires.
widgetLabelInName_summary_fail_name: {{element}}: the accessible name of this component (from {{sources}}) does not contain its visible label "{{visibleLabel}}".
widgetLabelInName_hint_fail_name: Make the attribute that names the element contain the visible label, ideally at its start, or remove it so the visible text names the element.
widgetLabelInName_summary_cantTell_symbo: {{element}}: the visible label "{{visibleLabel}}" of this component may be a symbol, and the {{sources}} does not contain it.
widgetLabelInName_hint_cantTell_symbol: If the visible text is a symbol (an icon glyph, "X" for close, ">" for next), check that the name says what the symbol means. If it is literal text, the name must contain it.
widgetLabelInName_summary_cantTell_nearM: {{element}}: the {{sources}} of this component differs from its visible label "{{visibleLabel}}" only by an abbreviation or by text in parentheses.
widgetLabelInName_hint_cantTell_nearMatc: Check whether the source still contains the visible label as a user would say it. RGAA excuses only punctuation and capital letters.
ariaRoleConformance_title: Role attributes are valid for the W3C validator
ariaRoleConformance_description: Checks, hidden content included, that every role attribute holds roles the W3C validator accepts, that the role is allowed on its element, and that an with a role has a non-empty alt or an ARIA name.
ariaRoleConformance_summary_fail_emptyRo: This <{{element}}> has a role attribute with no value.
ariaRoleConformance_hint_fail_emptyRole: Remove the empty role attribute, or give it a WAI-ARIA role.
ariaRoleConformance_summary_fail_unknown: role="{{value}}" on this <{{element}}> contains "{{token}}", which is not a role the W3C validator accepts.
ariaRoleConformance_hint_fail_unknownRol: Use lowercase WAI-ARIA role names only, and remove tokens that are not concrete roles (abstract roles such as widget are not allowed).
ariaRoleConformance_summary_fail_roleNot: role="{{role}}" is not allowed on this <{{element}}>.
ariaRoleConformance_hint_fail_roleNotAll: Use an element whose native role fits, or a role that ARIA in HTML allows on this element.
ariaRoleConformance_summary_fail_imgRole: This has a role attribute and an empty alt.
ariaRoleConformance_hint_fail_imgRoleEmp: Remove the role from a decorative image, or give an image that carries a role a text alternative.
ariaRoleConformance_summary_fail_imgRole: This has a role attribute but no alt, aria-label or aria-labelledby attribute.
ariaRoleConformance_hint_fail_imgRoleNoN: Add an alt attribute (or an ARIA name) to the image.
ariaRoleConformance_summary_cantTell_img: This has role="presentation" with an empty or missing alt, which the W3C validator reports as an error.
ariaRoleConformance_hint_cantTell_imgPre: RGAA 1.2.1 accepts role="presentation" to mark a decorative image. Check how the audit treats the validator error, or use alt="" alone.
ariaAttributeConformance_title: aria-* attributes are valid for the W3C validator
ariaAttributeConformance_description: Checks, hidden content included, that every aria-* attribute is one the W3C validator knows, has a valid value, is allowed on its element and role, and does not contradict a native attribute, and that roles carry the attributes the validator requires.
ariaAttributeConformance_summary_fail_un: {{attr}} on this <{{element}}> is not an ARIA attribute the W3C validator knows.
ariaAttributeConformance_hint_fail_unkno: Correct the attribute name (for example aria-labelledby, not aria-labeledby) or remove it.
ariaAttributeConformance_summary_fail_in: {{attr}}="{{value}}" on this <{{element}}> is not a valid value.
ariaAttributeConformance_hint_fail_inval: Use a value the attribute allows, written exactly (lowercase tokens, no surrounding spaces). An ID reference must not be empty, and aria-activedescendant must point to an existing element.
ariaAttributeConformance_hint_fail_attri: Remove the attribute, or use an element or a role that supports it.
ariaAttributeConformance_summary_fail_at: {{attr}} is not allowed on this <{{element}}> with role="{{role}}".
ariaAttributeConformance_hint_fail_attri: Remove the attribute, or use a role that supports it.
ariaAttributeConformance_summary_fail_na: {{attr}} is not allowed on this <{{element}}>, which cannot be named.
ariaAttributeConformance_hint_fail_namin: Remove the attribute or move the name to an element that can be named. Inside a button or link, the text content already gives the name.
ariaAttributeConformance_summary_fail_na: {{attr}} is not allowed on this <{{element}}> with role="{{role}}", a role that cannot be named.
ariaAttributeConformance_hint_fail_namin: Remove the attribute, or move the name to an element that can be named.
ariaAttributeConformance_summary_fail_na: aria-checked is not allowed on <input type="{{type}}">.
ariaAttributeConformance_hint_fail_nativ: Remove aria-checked: the checked state of the input is exposed natively.
Remove the ARIA attribute: the native attribute already gives the state.
ariaAttributeConformance_summary_fail_na: aria-placeholder is not allowed on this <{{element}}>, which has a placeholder attribute.
ariaAttributeConformance_hint_fail_nativ: Remove aria-placeholder and keep the placeholder attribute.
ariaAttributeConformance_summary_fail_na: aria-hidden is not allowed on the <html> element.
aria-hidden="true" is not allowed on the <body> element.
ariaAttributeConformance_hint_fail_nativ: Remove aria-hidden from <body>: it would hide the whole page from assistive technologies.
ariaAttributeConformance_summary_fail_mi: This <{{element}}> has role="{{role}}" but no {{attr}} attribute, which the role requires.
ariaAttributeConformance_hint_fail_missi: Add the attribute with the current value, or use a native element that has this role.
markupValidationReview_title: The generated source code passes the W3C validator
markupValidationReview_description: Reads the W3C validator report on the generated source, given as the validator.report probe, and fails the errors it lists; without a report it asks a person to run the validator (RGAA 8.2.1).
markupValidationReview_summary_fail_erro: The W3C validator reports an error in the generated source, line {{line}}: {{message}}
markupValidationReview_hint_fail_error: Correct the markup so that it follows the HTML writing rules: tags, attributes and values written as HTML allows, tags nested, opened and closed correctly, unique id values and no attribute twice on one element (RGAA 8.2.1).
markupValidationReview_summary_cantTell_: The validator could not check the page: {{message}}
The W3C validator reports {{count}} errors in the original source, the first at line {{line}}: {{message}}. RGAA 8.2.1 validates the generated source, where the browser may have repaired them.
The W3C validator reports no error in the original source. RGAA 8.2.1 validates the generated source, which scripts may change.
The validator report has {{cap}} messages or more and the engine reads the first {{cap}}, none of them an error, so the rest could not be checked.
markupValidationReview_hint_cantTell_rep: Validate the generated source of the page, the page after its scripts have run, with the W3C Nu HTML Checker, and pass its messages as the validator.report probe with source: 'generated' (RGAA 8.2.1).
markupValidationReview_summary_cantTell_: Run the W3C validator on the generated source code of this page: the engine cannot see unclosed or misnested tags, repeated attributes and other errors the browser repairs.
markupValidationReview_hint_cantTell_pag: Validate the generated source (for example with the W3C Nu HTML Checker) and check that tags, attributes and values follow the writing rules, tags are nested, opened and closed correctly, id values are unique and no attribute appears twice on one element (RGAA 8.2.1).
ariaListItemRoles_title: ARIA lists use role="listitem" for their items
ariaListItemRoles_description: Checks that the children of an element with role="list" have role="listitem", which RGAA requires of a list built with ARIA.
ariaListItemRoles_summary_cantTell_li: This role="list" holds <li> elements without role="listitem".
ariaListItemRoles_summary_cantTell_other: This role="list" has children without role="listitem".
ariaListItemRoles_hint_cantTell: If the content reads as a list, build it with <ul> or <ol> and <li>, or give each item role="listitem".
frameTitleAttributePresent_description: Checks that every <iframe> and <frame> has a title attribute, unless it is hidden with aria-hidden="true".
frameTitleAttributePresent_hint_fail: Add a title attribute that says what the frame contains. aria-label does not replace it.
frameTitleNotEmpty_description: Checks that the title attribute of every <iframe> and <frame> that has one is not empty.
frameTitleNotEmpty_summary_fail: This <{{element}}> has an empty title attribute.
frameTitleNotEmpty_hint_fail: Write in the title what the frame contains, for example the name of the map or video it shows.
viewportZoomReview_title: Text can reach 200% zoom despite a viewport meta tag that limits zoom
viewportZoomReview_description: Flags a <meta name="viewport"> that disables zoom or caps it below 200%, for a person to check that text still reaches 200% with the browser text zoom, the browser graphic zoom or a zoom control of the site.
viewportZoomReview_summary_cantTell: This viewport meta tag limits zoom ({{reasons}}).
viewportZoomReview_hint_cantTell: Check that all text in the page can be enlarged to 200% with the browser text zoom, the browser graphic zoom, or a zoom control provided by the site. One of the three is enough. Removing the restriction is simpler.
metaRefreshNoUrlTiming_title: Meta refresh waits 20 hours or more
metaRefreshNoUrlTiming_description: Checks that a <meta http-equiv="refresh"> that reloads the page waits at least 20 hours.
metaRefreshNoUrlTiming_summary_fail: This page reloads itself every {{delay}} seconds, less than 20 hours.
metaRefreshNoUrlTiming_hint_fail: Remove the meta refresh, or update the content with a script the visitor can stop, relaunch or slow down.
embeddedRefreshReview_title: Embedded content that may refresh itself lets the user control the refresh
embeddedRefreshReview_description: Flags <object>, <embed>, <canvas> and scripted <svg> elements, for a person to check whether they refresh their content on their own and, if so, whether the user can stop, slow down or be warned of the refresh.
embeddedRefreshReview_summary_cantTell: This element may refresh its content on its own. Check whether it does, and whether the user can control the refresh.
embeddedRefreshReview_hint_cantTell: A refresh passes when the user can stop and restart it, can make the delay at least ten times longer, is warned in time to do so, or when the delay is at least twenty hours.
metaRedirectImmediate_description: Checks whether a <meta http-equiv="refresh"> that sends the visitor to another address waits before doing so.
metaRedirectImmediate_summary_cantTell: This page sends the visitor to another address after {{delay}} seconds.
metaRedirectImmediate_hint_cantTell: Check whether it leaves an obsolete address for the new version of the page. If not, make the redirect immediate (content="0; url=…").
mainElementStructure_title: Main content uses one visible <main> element
mainElementStructure_description: Checks that the main content is a <main> element and that every other <main> carries the hidden attribute, on HTML5 pages.
mainElementStructure_summary_fail_extraM: This <main> element is not the first one on the page and has no hidden attribute.
mainElementStructure_hint_fail_extraMain: Keep one visible <main> element. Give every other <main> the hidden attribute: CSS or aria-hidden alone is not enough.
mainElementStructure_summary_fail_roleMa: The main content is marked with role="main" but the page has no <main> element.
mainElementStructure_hint_fail_roleMainO: Use a <main> element for the main content.
mainElementStructure_summary_cantTell_no: The page has no <main> element and no role="main".
mainElementStructure_hint_cantTell_noMai: Check where the main content is, and wrap it in a <main> element.
mainElementStructure_summary_cantTell_hi: This <main> element is hidden by an ancestor but has no hidden attribute of its own.
mainElementStructure_hint_cantTell_hidde: Check that only one <main> can ever be visible, and give the others the hidden attribute.
mainElementStructure_summary_cantTell_al: Every <main> element on the page has the hidden attribute.
mainElementStructure_hint_cantTell_allHi: Check that one <main> element is shown when the page is used.
headingRoleLevelPresent_title: ARIA headings have an aria-level attribute
headingRoleLevelPresent_description: Checks that each element with role="heading" also has an aria-level attribute.
headingRoleLevelPresent_summary_fail_mis: This element has role="heading" but no aria-level attribute.
headingRoleLevelPresent_summary_fail_not: This element has role="heading" and aria-level="{{value}}", which is not a number.
headingRoleLevelPresent_hint_fail: Add aria-level with the heading level (for example aria-level="2"), or use an <h1>-<h6> element instead.
headingContentPresent_description: Checks that each heading holds text or an image with a text alternative, rather than being empty or named only by attributes.
headingContentPresent_summary_fail_empty: This heading is empty: it has no text and no image with a text alternative.
headingContentPresent_hint_fail_empty: Put the heading text inside the heading, or remove the heading if it is not needed.
headingContentPresent_summary_cantTell_n: This heading has no text in its content; its only name, "{{name}}", comes from an attribute.
headingContentPresent_summary_cantTell_d: This heading has no text in its content; its only name comes from an aria-label inside it.
headingContentPresent_hint_cantTell_name: Check whether the heading is relevant to someone who sees the page. Put its text in the heading itself rather than in title or aria-label.
headingContentPresent_summary_cantTell_c: This heading has content but no text that assistive technologies read: hidden text, an image with no text alternative, CSS-generated text or an embedded element.
headingContentPresent_hint_cantTell_cont: Check what the heading shows. Give it text, or give its image a text alternative, so the heading says what the section is about.
thScopeRowCol_title: Table headers use scope="row" or scope="col"
thScopeRowCol_description: Flags a <th> with scope="rowgroup" or scope="colgroup", which RGAA does not accept, for a person to tell whether it covers a whole row or column.
thScopeRowCol_hint_cantTell: If the header covers a whole row or column, use scope="row" or scope="col". If it covers only part of one, remove scope, give the <th> a unique id and list that id in the headers attribute of the cells it covers.
titlePlaceholderIdentical_title: A form field's title and placeholder are identical
titlePlaceholderIdentical_description: Asks about form fields whose title and placeholder are both present but differ: RGAA's glossary entry "Étiquette de champ de formulaire" requires them to be identical.
titlePlaceholderIdentical_summary_cantTe: The title ("{{title}}") and the placeholder ("{{placeholder}}") of this form field differ.
titlePlaceholderIdentical_hint_cantTell: A screen reader may read the placeholder instead of the title. Give both attributes the same text, or remove the one that is not needed.
skipLinkPresent_title: Pages have a skip link to the main content
skipLinkPresent_description: Checks that a page with navigation before its main content has a working same-page link to that content.
skipLinkPresent_summary_fail_noLink: Navigation comes before the main content, and no link on the page leads to the main content.
skipLinkPresent_hint_fail_noLink: Add a link at the start of the page, such as "Skip to content", whose href is the id of the <main> element.
skipLinkPresent_summary_fail_targetMissi: This skip link points to "{{href}}", which does not exist in the page.
skipLinkPresent_hint_fail_targetMissing: Point the skip link at the id of the <main> element, or add that id.
skipLinkPresent_summary_cantTell_targetN: This skip link points to "{{href}}", which is not the start of the main content: links or other focusable elements lie between them.
skipLinkPresent_summary_cantTell_targetH: This skip link points to "{{href}}", which is hidden.
skipLinkPresent_hint_cantTell_target: Check that activating the link moves reading and keyboard focus to the start of the main content. Pointing it at the <main> element does this.
skipLinkPresent_summary_cantTell_noNavig: No link on the page leads to the main content, and no navigation block comes before it.
skipLinkPresent_hint_cantTell_noNavigati: A skip link to the main content is needed unless the site is a single page that has no use for one. Check the content before <main>, and add a link to it if that content repeats or can be skipped.
skipLinkPresent_summary_cantTell_noMain: The page has no <main> element, so the main content zone and a link to it could not be found.
skipLinkPresent_hint_cantTell_noMain: Mark the main content with a <main> element, and add a link before it, such as "Skip to content", whose href is the id of that element.
skipLinkPlacement_title: Skip links are visible and at the same place on every page
skipLinkPlacement_description: Checks that the link to the main content is visible, at least when it takes focus, and that the site’s other pages show it at the same place and in the same focus order (RGAA 12.7.2).
skipLinkPlacement_summary_fail_notVisibl: This skip link is not visible, and it stays hidden when it takes focus (no size, outside the page, clipped, transparent or visibility: hidden).
skipLinkPlacement_hint_fail_notVisible: Show the skip link at all times, or at least when it takes keyboard focus, for instance by moving it back into view in a :focus rule (RGAA 12.7.2).
skipLinkPlacement_summary_fail_positionD: This skip link is not at the same place on other pages of the site, measured at the same window width: {{pages}}.
skipLinkPlacement_hint_fail_positionDiff: Place the skip link at the same position on every page, usually first in the page header (RGAA 12.7.2).
skipLinkPlacement_summary_cantTell_visib: Whether this skip link is visible could not be settled: something may cover it, it is animated when it takes focus, or the page was not rendered.
skipLinkPlacement_hint_cantTell_visibili: Tab to the skip link and check that it is visible when it has focus (RGAA 12.7.2).
skipLinkPlacement_summary_cantTell_order: This skip link comes at another place in the focus order on other pages of the site: {{pages}}.
skipLinkPlacement_hint_cantTell_orderDif: Check that the skip link comes in the same order relative to the rest of the page on every page (RGAA 12.7.2).
skipLinkPlacement_summary_cantTell_viewp: The other pages of the site were measured at another window width, so the place of this skip link could not be compared.
skipLinkPlacement_hint_cantTell_viewport: Measure every page at the same window width, or check on the site that the skip link is at the same place on every page (RGAA 12.7.2).
skipLinkPlacement_summary_cantTell_singl: Only this page was available, so whether the skip link is at the same place and in the same order on the other pages of the site could not be checked.
skipLinkPlacement_hint_cantTell_singlePa: Scan several pages of the site and pass their skip link records as the crawl.skipLinks probe, or check on the site that the skip link is at the same place and in the same order on every page (RGAA 12.7.2).
htmlNestingValid_title: HTML elements are nested as HTML allows
htmlNestingValid_description: Checks, hidden content included, that lists, description lists, links, buttons, server-side image maps and <main> elements are nested as the HTML standard and the W3C validator require.
htmlNestingValid_summary_fail_listChild: This <{{element}}> is a direct child of a <{{parent}}>, which may only hold <li>, <script> and <template>.
htmlNestingValid_hint_fail_listChild: Wrap the content in an <li>, or move it out of the list.
htmlNestingValid_summary_fail_listText: This <{{element}}> has text directly inside it, outside any <li>.
htmlNestingValid_hint_fail_listText: Put the text in an <li>, or move it out of the list.
htmlNestingValid_summary_fail_listItemPa: This <li> is inside a <{{parent}}>, not a <ul>, <ol> or <menu>.
htmlNestingValid_hint_fail_listItemParen: Put list items in a <ul>, <ol> or <menu>. A role on the parent does not make it a list for HTML.
htmlNestingValid_summary_fail_dlChild: This <{{element}}> is not allowed directly inside this description list’s <{{parent}}>.
htmlNestingValid_hint_fail_dlChild: A <dl> may only hold <dt>, <dd>, <div> groups, <script> and <template>; a <div> group only <dt>, <dd>, <script> and <template>.
htmlNestingValid_summary_fail_dlText: This <{{element}}> of a description list has text directly inside it.
htmlNestingValid_hint_fail_dlText: Put the text in a <dt> or <dd>.
htmlNestingValid_summary_fail_dlGroupOrd: The <dt> and <dd> elements in this <{{element}}> are not groups of one or more <dt> followed by one or more <dd>.
htmlNestingValid_hint_fail_dlGroupOrder: Start each group with its <dt> terms and end it with their <dd> descriptions. A <div> group holds exactly one such group.
htmlNestingValid_summary_fail_dlMixedGro: This <dl> mixes <div> groups with <dt> or <dd> elements placed directly inside it.
htmlNestingValid_hint_fail_dlMixedGroups: Either wrap every group in a <div>, or none of them.
htmlNestingValid_summary_fail_dlItemPare: This <{{element}}> is inside a <{{parent}}>, not a <dl> or a <div> child of a <dl>.
htmlNestingValid_summary_fail_interactiv: This <{{element}}> is interactive content nested in <{{ancestor}}>.
htmlNestingValid_hint_fail_interactiveDe: Move the control out of the link or button. HTML does not allow interactive content inside <a> or <button>, even when disabled or hidden.
htmlNestingValid_summary_fail_tabindexDe: This <{{element}}> has a tabindex attribute and is nested in <{{ancestor}}>.
htmlNestingValid_hint_fail_tabindexDesce: Remove the tabindex attribute, or move the element out of the link or button.
htmlNestingValid_summary_fail_ismapOutsi: This has the ismap attribute but no ancestor.
htmlNestingValid_hint_fail_ismapOutsideL: Remove the ismap attribute, or put the image in a link with an href.
htmlNestingValid_summary_fail_extraMain: This <main> element is not the first one on the page without the hidden attribute.
htmlNestingValid_hint_fail_extraMain: Keep one <main> element without the hidden attribute. CSS, aria-hidden or a hidden ancestor does not count.
htmlNestingValid_summary_cantTell_otherD: The page declares a doctype other than HTML5, so HTML5 nesting rules may not apply to it.
htmlNestingValid_hint_cantTell_otherDoct: Run the W3C validator on the generated source and check the nesting against the declared doctype.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_title: HTML elements and attribute values are valid
htmlElementsAttributesValid_description: Checks, hidden content included, for obsolete or unknown elements and for invalid dir, id, lang, xml:lang, scope, headers, optgroup label, image button alt and autocomplete values, as the W3C validator reports them.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_summary_fail: The <{{element}}> element is obsolete in HTML.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_hint_fail_ob: Replace it with a current element, and use CSS for presentation.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_summary_fail: The <{{element}}> element is not defined by HTML and is not a valid custom element name.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_hint_fail_un: Use an HTML element, or a custom element name with a hyphen that HTML does not reserve.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_summary_fail: The dir attribute value "{{value}}" is not valid on <{{element}}>.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_hint_fail_di: Use ltr, rtl or auto, with no spaces (only ltr or rtl on <bdo>).
htmlElementsAttributesValid_summary_fail: The id attribute value "{{value}}" is empty or contains whitespace.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_hint_fail_id: Give the element an id with at least one character and no spaces.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_summary_fail: The lang attribute value "{{value}}" is not a well-formed language tag.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_hint_fail_la: Use a BCP 47 language tag, such as fr, en-GB or zh-Hant, with hyphens and no spaces.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_summary_fail: xml:lang="{{xmlLang}}" is not matched by a lang attribute with the same value on this <{{element}}>.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_hint_fail_xm: Give the element a lang attribute with the same value as xml:lang, or remove xml:lang.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_summary_fail: The scope attribute value "{{value}}" is not valid on <th>.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_hint_fail_sc: Use row, col, rowgroup or colgroup, with no spaces.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_summary_fail: The scope attribute is not allowed on <{{element}}>.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_hint_fail_sc: Put scope on the <th> header cell, or remove it.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_summary_fail: The headers attribute names "{{target}}", but no <th> of the same table has that id.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_hint_fail_he: List the ids of the table’s own <th> header cells in headers.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_summary_fail: This cell has an empty headers attribute.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_hint_fail_he: List the ids of the header cells, or remove the attribute.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_hint_fail_op: Give the <optgroup> a label attribute that names the group.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_summary_fail: This image button has no alt attribute, or an empty one.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_hint_fail_in: Give the <input type="image"> an alt attribute that says what the button does.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_summary_fail: The autocomplete value "{{value}}" is not valid on <{{element}}>.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_hint_fail_au: Use on or off, or one autofill field name with its optional prefixes (for example "shipping postal-code"). A form takes only on or off, and a hidden input takes neither.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_summary_fail: The autofill field name "{{fieldName}}" is not allowed on an input of type "{{inputType}}".
htmlElementsAttributesValid_hint_fail_au: Use a field name that suits this type of input, or change the input type.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_summary_fail: The autocomplete attribute is not allowed on an input of type "{{inputType}}".
htmlElementsAttributesValid_hint_fail_au: Remove the autocomplete attribute from this input.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_summary_cant: The page declares a doctype other than HTML5, so HTML5 writing rules may not apply to it.
htmlElementsAttributesValid_hint_cantTel: Run the W3C validator on the generated source and check elements and attribute values against the declared doctype.
linkStateColorsReview_title: Link states shown by color alone contrast 3:1 with the surrounding text
linkStateColorsReview_description: Checks that a link in a run of text, shown only by color, keeps a contrast of 3:1 with the surrounding text in each visited, active, hover or focus state shown by another color, and asks when the states cannot be put on the link (RGAA 10.6.1).
linkStateColorsReview_summary_fail_lowCo: This link in a run of text is shown only by its color, and in these states that color contrasts below 3:1 with the surrounding text: {{states}} (lowest {{ratio}}:1, {{color}} against {{textColor}}).
linkStateColorsReview_hint_fail_lowContr: Give the link a color with a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 with the surrounding text in each state, or mark it in those states by more than color, such as an underline (RGAA 10.6.1).
linkStateColorsReview_summary_cantTell_s: This link in a run of text is shown only by its color, and a style rule changes that color in these states: {{states}}.
linkStateColorsReview_summary_cantTell_b: This link in a run of text is shown only by its color, and no style rule sets that color, so the browser's own visited color, a different one, applies.
linkStateColorsReview_summary_cantTell_u: This link in a run of text is shown only by its color, and a style sheet that could not be read may change that color in some of its states.
linkStateColorsReview_hint_cantTell: Put the link in each state (visited, active, hovered, focused) and check that its color contrasts at least 3:1 with the surrounding text, or give the link a mark other than color, such as an underline.
orientationContentParity_title: Content stays the same in portrait and landscape
orientationContentParity_description: Lays the page out as portrait and as landscape and fails content shown in one orientation and missing from the other, and asks about elements an orientation media query hides when the page cannot be laid out (RGAA 13.9.1).
orientationContentParity_summary_fail_mi: In portrait, this <{{element}}> is hidden and its content ("{{text}}") is not shown anywhere else.
In landscape, this <{{element}}> is hidden and its content ("{{text}}") is not shown anywhere else.
orientationContentParity_hint_fail_missi: Offer the same content in both orientations. Its presentation may change, but it must stay available (RGAA 13.9.1).
orientationContentParity_summary_cantTel: In portrait, this <{{element}}> is hidden, and with it the main content of the page.
In landscape, this <{{element}}> is hidden, and with it the main content of the page.
orientationContentParity_hint_cantTell_m: Check that the page can be used in both orientations, unless one orientation is essential to it (RGAA 13.9.1).
orientationContentParity_hint_cantTell: Check that the same content is offered in portrait and in landscape, even if it is presented or reached differently (RGAA 13.9.1). This is not required when one orientation is essential.
keyboardOnlyEventHandlers_title: Keyboard-only inline event handlers should have a pointer equivalent
keyboardOnlyEventHandlers_description: Flags elements that are not interactive natively and have an inline key handler (onkeydown, onkeyup, onkeypress) but no click or pointer handler, for a person to check that the action also works with a mouse, touch or stylus.
keyboardOnlyEventHandlers_summary_cantTe: This <{{element}}> has {{attrs}} but no click or pointer handler.
keyboardOnlyEventHandlers_hint_cantTell: Check that the action also works with a mouse, touch or stylus, on this element or on another element of the page that does the same thing (RGAA 7.3.1). A handler attached from a script file does not show in the markup.
linkContextReview_title: Generic links whose only context is outside RGAA's list are reviewed
linkContextReview_description: Flags links named by a generic phrase or a bare file format whose only context is an aria-describedby text or a <dd>, <dt>, <blockquote> or <figcaption>, which RGAA's glossary entry "Contexte du lien" does not list, for a person to check RGAA 6.1.
linkContextReview_summary_cantTell_descr: The link "{{name}}" has a generic name, and its only context is the text its aria-describedby points to, which RGAA does not count as link context.
linkContextReview_summary_cantTell_conta: The link "{{name}}" has a generic name, and its only context is the text of the <{{element}}> around it, which RGAA does not count as link context.
linkContextReview_hint_cantTell: Check whether the sentence, paragraph, list item, table cell or preceding heading makes the link explicit. Otherwise, put its destination in the link text.
doctypePresent_description: Checks that the document has a doctype, written before the <html> element.
doctypePresent_hint_fail: Start the page with <!DOCTYPE html>, before the <html> element.
doctypePosition_title: The doctype comes before the <html> tag
doctypePosition_description: Checks that a declared doctype comes before the <html> tag in the source, reading the page source given as the page.source probe when the parser has dropped it (RGAA 8.1.3).
doctypePosition_summary_fail_afterHtml: The page source declares its doctype after the <html> tag, so browsers ignore it.
doctypePosition_hint_fail_afterHtml: Move the doctype to the very start of the page, before the <html> tag: <!DOCTYPE html> (RGAA 8.1.3).
doctypePosition_summary_cantTell_sourceM: The page has no doctype once parsed. Without its source, whether one is missing or written after the <html> tag could not be told.
doctypePosition_hint_cantTell_sourceMiss: Look at the page source as the server sends it, or pass its start as the page.source probe: a doctype must come before the <html> tag (RGAA 8.1.3).
doctypePosition_summary_cantTell_sourceT: The start of the page source given shows neither a doctype nor the <html> tag, so where the doctype sits could not be told.
doctypePosition_hint_cantTell_sourceTooS: Look at the page source as the server sends it: a doctype must come before the <html> tag (RGAA 8.1.3).
doctypeValid_description: Checks that a declared doctype is the HTML5 doctype or one of the doctypes the W3C recommends.
doctypeValid_summary_fail: The page declares a doctype that is neither HTML5 nor a W3C recommended one.
doctypeValid_hint_fail: Start the page with <!DOCTYPE html>, or with a doctype from the W3C list of recommended doctypes.
presentationalElementsAbsent_description: Checks that the page contains none of the presentational elements RGAA lists, such as <font>, <center> or <big>.
presentationalElementsAbsent_hint_fail: Replace it with the element that carries the meaning, or with CSS for the presentation.
presentationalAttributesAbsent_descripti: Checks that no HTML element carries one of the presentational attributes RGAA lists, such as align, bgcolor or border.
presentationalAttributesAbsent_hint_fail: Remove them and set the presentation in CSS instead.
optgroupLabelPresent_description: Checks that every <optgroup> in a <select> has a label attribute.
optgroupLabelPresent_summary_fail_missin: This option group has no label attribute.
optgroupLabelPresent_hint_fail: Give the <optgroup> a label attribute naming what its options have in common.
optgroupLabelNotEmpty_title: Option group labels are not empty
optgroupLabelNotEmpty_description: Checks that the label attribute of every <optgroup> in a <select> that has one is not empty.
optgroupLabelNotEmpty_summary_fail: This option group has an empty label attribute.
optgroupLabelNotEmpty_hint_fail: Write in the label what the options of the group have in common, for example the region that groups a list of cities.
listboxOptionGroupsAbsent_title: ARIA listboxes do not group options
listboxOptionGroupsAbsent_description: Checks that no element with role="listbox" groups its options with role="group", which RGAA does not accept in place of <select> and <optgroup>.
listboxOptionGroupsAbsent_summary_fail: This listbox groups its options with role="group".
listboxOptionGroupsAbsent_hint_fail: Use a <select> with <optgroup> elements, each with a label, when the options need grouping. ARIA cannot convey option groups.
labelForTargetValid_title: Labels point to a form field
labelForTargetValid_description: Checks that the for attribute of each <label> matches the id of a form field it can label.
labelForTargetValid_summary_fail_empty: This label has an empty for attribute, so it labels no field.
labelForTargetValid_summary_fail_missing: This label points to id "{{value}}", which no element in its tree has.
labelForTargetValid_summary_fail_notLabe: This label points to id "{{value}}", which belongs to a <{{element}}>, not a form field.
labelForTargetValid_hint_fail: Set the for attribute to the id of the field this label names, or remove it and put the field inside the label.
layoutTableNoDataMarkup_title: Layout tables use no data table markup
layoutTableNoDataMarkup_description: Checks that a table marked as layout (role="presentation" or "none") has no caption, header cells, colgroup, summary, or scope, headers or axis attributes, and asks when such a table looks like a data table.
layoutTableNoDataMarkup_summary_fail: This layout table uses data table markup: {{markup}}.
layoutTableNoDataMarkup_hint_fail: Remove the data table markup, or, if the table holds data, remove role="presentation" and keep the headers.
layoutTableNoDataMarkup_summary_cantTell: This table is marked as layout but looks like a data table, with a full header row or column; it uses data table markup: {{markup}}.
layoutTableNoDataMarkup_hint_cantTell_da: If the table holds data, remove role="presentation" so that its headers are exposed. If it is for layout, remove the data table markup.
figureCaptionStructure_title: Images with a caption use the figure structure RGAA describes
figureCaptionStructure_description: Checks that a <figure> holding an image and a <figcaption> has role="figure" or "group" and an aria-label matching the caption.
figureCaptionStructure_summary_fail_role: This figure holds an image and a caption but has no role="figure" or role="group".
figureCaptionStructure_summary_fail_labe: This figure holds an image and a caption but has no aria-label repeating the caption.
figureCaptionStructure_summary_fail_mism: This figure's aria-label differs from its caption.
figureCaptionStructure_hint_fail: Give the <figure> role="figure" and an aria-label with the same text as its <figcaption>.
videoCaptionsTrackKind_description: Checks that a <video> with text tracks has at least one <track kind="captions">, not only subtitles, and asks when its subtitles may be translations.
videoCaptionsTrackKind_summary_fail: This video has text tracks, but none with kind="captions".
videoCaptionsTrackKind_hint_fail: Mark the track that carries the captions with kind="captions".
videoCaptionsTrackKind_summary_cantTell_: This video has only subtitles tracks, none in the language of the video; they may be translations rather than captions.
videoCaptionsTrackKind_hint_cantTell_tra: If a track carries captions for the video’s own language, mark it kind="captions" with the matching srclang. If the tracks are translations, check that captions are provided some other way (RGAA 4.3.1).
dirAttributeValid_title: dir attributes are ltr or rtl
dirAttributeValid_description: Checks that every dir attribute is ltr or rtl, the two values RGAA accepts.
dirAttributeValid_summary_fail_auto: This element uses dir="auto"; RGAA accepts only ltr or rtl.
dirAttributeValid_summary_fail_invalid: This element has dir="{{value}}", which is neither ltr nor rtl.
dirAttributeValid_hint_fail: Set dir to ltr (left to right) or rtl (right to left), whichever the text reads in.
svgHiddenNoAlternative_title: Hidden decorative SVGs carry no text alternative
svgHiddenNoAlternative_description: Checks that an <svg> with aria-hidden="true" has no aria-label, aria-labelledby, title attribute, or non-empty <title> or <desc>.
svgHiddenNoAlternative_summary_fail: This SVG is hidden with aria-hidden="true" but carries a text alternative: {{alternatives}}.
svgHiddenNoAlternative_hint_fail: If the image is decorative, remove the text alternative. If it carries information, remove aria-hidden and give it role="img" and a text alternative.
roleImgAriaName_title: Elements with role="img" are named with aria-labelledby or aria-label
roleImgAriaName_description: Checks that each exposed element with role="img" (other than and an outer
roleImgAriaName_summary_fail_titleOnly: This <{{element}}> with role="img" is named only by its title attribute; RGAA accepts only aria-labelledby or aria-label.
roleImgAriaName_summary_fail_missing: This <{{element}}> with role="img" has no text alternative.
roleImgAriaName_hint_fail: Give it an aria-label, or an aria-labelledby that points to text describing the image.
roleImgAriaName_summary_cantTell_svgTitl: This <{{element}}> with role="img" is named only by a <title> child.
roleImgAriaName_hint_cantTell_svgTitle: RGAA 1.1.1 accepts only aria-labelledby or aria-label for role="img". Check that assistive technologies render the <title>, or point aria-labelledby at it.
svgRoleImg_title: SVGs with a text alternative have role="img"
svgRoleImg_description: Checks that an <svg> named by aria-labelledby, aria-label or <title> has role="img", and that its name comes from aria-labelledby or aria-label.
svgRoleImg_summary_fail_missingRole: This <svg> has a text alternative ({{alternatives}}) but no role="img".
svgRoleImg_hint_fail_missingRole: Add role="img" to the <svg>, and name it with aria-label or aria-labelledby. If the image is decorative, remove the alternative and add aria-hidden="true".
svgRoleImg_summary_cantTell_titleOnly: This <svg role="img"> is named only by its <title> element.
svgRoleImg_hint_cantTell_titleOnly: RGAA 1.1.5 lists aria-labelledby and aria-label as the sources for an <svg>. Check that assistive technologies render the <title>, or point aria-labelledby at it.
objectImageRoleImg_title: Image objects have role="img" and a text alternative
objectImageRoleImg_description: Checks that each <object type="image/…"> has role="img" and a text alternative (aria-labelledby, aria-label or title), or is followed by a link or button to an alternative content.
objectImageRoleImg_summary_cantTell_noRo: This image object has a text alternative ({{source}}) but no role="img".
objectImageRoleImg_hint_cantTell_noRole: RGAA 1.1.6 asks for a text alternative and role="img". Add role="img", or check that the alternative is rendered by assistive technologies.
objectImageRoleImg_summary_cantTell_adja: This image object has no text alternative but is followed by a link or button.
objectImageRoleImg_hint_cantTell_adjacen: Check that the link or button gives access to an alternative content. If not, give the object role="img" and an aria-label or aria-labelledby.
objectImageRoleImg_summary_cantTell_fall: This image object has no text alternative, only content between <object> and </object>.
objectImageRoleImg_hint_cantTell_fallbac: RGAA 1.1.6 does not count that content as a text alternative. Give the object role="img" and an aria-label or aria-labelledby, or follow it with a link or button to an alternative content.
objectImageRoleImg_summary_fail: This image object has no text alternative and no link or button to an alternative content after it.
objectImageRoleImg_hint_fail: Give the object role="img" and an aria-label or aria-labelledby, or follow it with a link or button to an alternative content.
embedImageRoleImg_title: Embedded images have role="img" and a text alternative
embedImageRoleImg_description: Checks that each <embed type="image/…"> has role="img" and a text alternative (aria-labelledby, aria-label or title), or is followed by a link or button to an alternative content.
embedImageRoleImg_summary_cantTell_noRol: This embedded image has a text alternative ({{source}}) but no role="img".
embedImageRoleImg_hint_cantTell_noRole: RGAA 1.1.7 asks for a text alternative and role="img". Add role="img", or check that the alternative is rendered by assistive technologies.
embedImageRoleImg_summary_cantTell_adjac: This embedded image has no text alternative but is followed by a link or button.
embedImageRoleImg_hint_cantTell_adjacent: Check that the link or button gives access to an alternative content. If not, give the <embed> role="img" and an aria-label or aria-labelledby.
embedImageRoleImg_summary_fail: This embedded image has no text alternative and no link or button to an alternative content after it.
embedImageRoleImg_hint_fail: Give the <embed> role="img" and an aria-label or aria-labelledby, or follow it with a link or button to an alternative content.
canvasRoleImg_title: <canvas> images have role="img" with an ARIA name, or fallback content
canvasRoleImg_description: Checks each <canvas> against RGAA 1.1.8: role="img" named by aria-labelledby or aria-label, or fallback content, or a link or button to an alternative content right after it.
canvasRoleImg_summary_fail_roleImg: This <canvas role="img"> has no aria-labelledby or aria-label; with role="img", fallback content, title and an adjacent link do not count.
canvasRoleImg_hint_fail_roleImg: Name the canvas with aria-label or aria-labelledby, or remove role="img" and put the alternative content between <canvas> and </canvas>.
canvasRoleImg_summary_fail_noRole: This <canvas> is named by {{source}} but has no role="img" and no fallback content.
canvasRoleImg_summary_fail: This <canvas> has no text alternative, no fallback content and no link or button to an alternative content after it.
canvasRoleImg_hint_fail: Give the canvas role="img" and an aria-label or aria-labelledby, or put alternative content between <canvas> and </canvas>, or follow it with a link or button to an alternative content.
canvasRoleImg_summary_cantTell_adjacent: This <canvas> has no alternative but is followed by a link or button.
canvasRoleImg_hint_cantTell_adjacent: Check that the link or button gives access to an alternative content. If not, give the canvas role="img" and an aria-label or aria-labelledby.
canvasDecorativeAriaHidden_title: Decorative <canvas> images have aria-hidden="true" and no alternative
canvasDecorativeAriaHidden_description: Checks that a <canvas> marked decorative has aria-hidden="true", no aria-labelledby, aria-label or title, and no alternative content inside it.
canvasDecorativeAriaHidden_summary_fail_: This <canvas> is hidden with aria-hidden="true" but carries an alternative: {{alternatives}}.
canvasDecorativeAriaHidden_hint_fail_hid: If the image is decorative, remove the alternative. If it carries information, remove aria-hidden and give it role="img" and an aria-label or aria-labelledby.
canvasDecorativeAriaHidden_summary_fail_: This <canvas role="{{role}}"> is marked decorative but has no aria-hidden="true".
canvasDecorativeAriaHidden_hint_fail_rol: Add aria-hidden="true" to a decorative canvas, and give it no aria-label, aria-labelledby or title.
canvasDecorativeAriaHidden_summary_cantT: This <canvas role="{{role}}"> has no aria-hidden="true" and has content between <canvas> and </canvas>.
canvasDecorativeAriaHidden_hint_cantTell: If the image carries information, remove the role and keep the content as its alternative. If it is decorative, add aria-hidden="true" and remove the content.
imgDecorativeNoAlternative_title: Decorative images have no aria-labelledby, aria-label or title
imgDecorativeNoAlternative_description: Checks that an marked decorative (alt="", aria-hidden="true" or role="presentation") has no aria-labelledby, aria-label or title attribute.
imgDecorativeNoAlternative_summary_fail: This image is hidden with aria-hidden="true" but has {{attributes}}.
imgDecorativeNoAlternative_hint_fail: If the image is decorative, remove these attributes. If it carries information, remove aria-hidden and give it an alt text.
imgDecorativeNoAlternative_summary_cantT: This image is marked decorative with {{marker}} but has {{attributes}}.
imgDecorativeNoAlternative_hint_cantTell: If the image is decorative, remove these attributes. If it carries information, give it an alt text that describes it.
areaAltSource_title: Linked image-map areas are named by alt or aria-label
areaAltSource_description: Checks that each linked <area> of a used image map takes its text alternative from alt or aria-label, the two sources RGAA accepts, not only from title or aria-labelledby.
areaAltSource_summary_fail: This <area> is named only by {{sources}}; RGAA accepts alt or aria-label.
areaAltSource_hint_fail: Put the text alternative in the alt attribute (or in aria-label).
fieldGroupLegend_title: Groups of form fields have a legend
fieldGroupLegend_description: Flags a <fieldset> without a legend, or a role="group" or role="radiogroup" without aria-label or aria-labelledby, holding form fields, for a person to decide whether it groups fields of the same kind.
fieldGroupLegend_summary_cantTell_fields: This fieldset groups form fields but has no legend.
fieldGroupLegend_summary_cantTell_group: This role="{{role}}" element groups form fields but has no aria-label or aria-labelledby.
fieldGroupLegend_hint_cantTell: If the fields are of the same kind (an address, a date, a set of choices), give the group a legend: a <legend> for a fieldset, aria-label or aria-labelledby for role="group" or role="radiogroup". Otherwise check that each field has a title, aria-label, aria-labelledby or aria-describedby that names the group.
radioGroupPresent_title: Radio buttons sharing a name are grouped
radioGroupPresent_description: Flags a set of radio buttons with the same name that is not inside one fieldset, role="group" or role="radiogroup", for a person to decide whether it needs grouping.
radioGroupPresent_summary_cantTell: The {{count}} radio buttons named "{{name}}" are not grouped in one fieldset or group.
radioGroupPresent_hint_cantTell: If the buttons answer a question their own labels don't state, put them in a <fieldset> with a <legend>, or in an element with role="radiogroup" and a name, so the question is announced with them. A set whose labels already say what they answer, such as a lone yes/no pair, may need no group (RGAA 11.5.1).
fakeList_title: Text laid out as a list uses list markup
fakeList_description: Flags consecutive lines or paragraphs that start with bullets or consecutive numbers but are not marked up as a list, for a person to decide whether they are one.
fakeList_summary_cantTell_unordered: These {{items}} lines start with the same bullet but are not marked up as a list.
fakeList_summary_cantTell_ordered: These {{items}} lines start with consecutive numbers but are not marked up as a list.
fakeList_hint_cantTell_unordered: If this is a list, use <ul> and <li> (or role="list" and role="listitem"), and style the bullets with CSS.
fakeList_hint_cantTell_ordered: If this is a list, use <ol> and <li> (or role="list" and role="listitem"), and let the list number the items.
lettersSpacedWithSpaces_title: Letters of a word are not spaced out with spaces
lettersSpacedWithSpaces_description: Flags text where four or more single letters in a row (three capitals when they are the whole text) are separated by spaces, for a person to confirm whether a word is spaced out that way.
lettersSpacedWithSpaces_summary_cantTell: The text "{{text}}" has its letters separated by spaces.
lettersSpacedWithSpaces_hint_cantTell: If this is a word, write it without spaces and use the CSS letter-spacing property for the spaced-out look.
imageAltLong_title: Text alternatives of images are short
imageAltLong_description: Flags an image whose text alternative is longer than 80 characters, for a person to decide whether it is short and concise enough.
imageAltLong_summary_cantTell: This image's text alternative is {{length}} characters long.
imageAltLong_hint_cantTell: Check that the alternative is short and concise for what the image conveys in context. A longer one can be right in the particular cases RGAA 1.3.9 allows. Put a detailed description in a long description next to the image or linked from it (RGAA 1.8).
complexTableSummary_title: Complex data tables have a summary
complexTableSummary_description: Flags a data table whose headers are not all in the first row or column, or head only a group of rows or columns, and that has no aria-describedby (nor, before HTML5, a summary attribute), for a person to check that a summary is available.
complexTableSummary_summary_cantTell: This table looks like a complex data table, and nothing marks a summary of its structure.
complexTableSummary_hint_cantTell: Check that a summary explains how the table is organised, in its <caption> or in a passage next to it, ideally linked with aria-describedby.
complexTableSummaryQuality_title: Complex data table summaries are relevant
complexTableSummaryQuality_description: Flags a complex data table that has a summary (caption, aria-describedby, or before HTML5 a summary attribute), for a person to check that it explains the nature and structure of the table.
complexTableSummaryQuality_summary_cantT: This table looks like a complex data table and has a summary. Check that it explains how the table is organised.
complexTableSummaryQuality_hint_cantTell: The summary should say what the table contains and how its headers are arranged, not only repeat its title. It can sit in the <caption>, hidden with CSS if needed, or in a passage linked with aria-describedby.
dataTableHeadersReview_title: Tables with no header cells are checked for unmarked headers
dataTableHeadersReview_description: Flags a table of at least two rows and two columns with no <th> and no columnheader or rowheader role, for a person to check whether it is a data table whose headers should be marked up.
dataTableHeadersReview_summary_cantTell: This table has no header cells. If it is a data table, check whether its first row or column holds headers.
dataTableHeadersReview_hint_cantTell: Mark each header that applies to a whole column or row with <th> (or role="columnheader" or role="rowheader" in an ARIA table). If the table is only used for layout, give it role="presentation" instead.
officeDocumentLink_title: Downloadable office documents are accessible or have an accessible version
officeDocumentLink_description: Flags each link or form that downloads an office document (PDF, Word, OpenDocument, spreadsheet, presentation, EPUB, RTF) for a person to check the document or its accessible version.
officeDocumentLink_hint_cantTell: Check that the document is accessible, or offer an accessible version, as a download or as an HTML page.
scriptedComponentsReview_title: Scripted components are compatible with assistive technologies
scriptedComponentsReview_description: On a page with script, asks a person to check every scripted component against RGAA 7.1 (name, role, value, settings and state changes exposed and rendered by assistive technologies, a name that contains the visible label), and lists the elements in the markup that look like scripted components as a starting point.
scriptedComponentsReview_summary_cantTel: Check every scripted component: the engine cannot see behaviour attached from script files, so this check is needed even when no candidate is listed.
scriptedComponentsReview_hint_cantTell_p: Check that each scripted component exposes its name, role, value, settings and state changes to assistive technologies (RGAA 7.1.1), is correctly rendered by them (7.1.2) and has a relevant name and role, with a name that contains its visible label (7.1.3), or that an accessible alternative exists. The candidates listed with this check come from the markup and are a starting point, not a complete list.
scriptedComponentsReview_summary_cantTel: This <{{element}}> has role="{{role}}", a widget role it does not have natively.
scriptedComponentsReview_hint_cantTell_w: Check with assistive technologies that this component exposes its name, role, value, settings and state changes, and that its name contains its visible label (RGAA 7.1).
scriptedComponentsReview_summary_cantTel: This <{{element}}> is made focusable with tabindex="{{tabindex}}" although it is not focusable natively.
scriptedComponentsReview_hint_cantTell_f: Check whether this element is a scripted component; if it is, check with assistive technologies that it exposes a relevant role, name, value and state (RGAA 7.1).
scriptedComponentsReview_summary_cantTel: This <{{element}}> has an inline {{attribute}} event handler.
scriptedComponentsReview_hint_cantTell_i: Check whether this element is a scripted component; if it is, check with assistive technologies that it exposes a relevant role, name, value and state (RGAA 7.1).
scriptedComponentsReview_hint_cantTell_c: Check with assistive technologies that this editing area exposes a relevant role, name and state, and that its changes are rendered (RGAA 7.1).
scriptedComponentsReview_summary_cantTel: This <{{element}}> has {{attribute}}, which a script usually updates.
scriptedComponentsReview_hint_cantTell_s: Check with assistive technologies that the state this attribute describes is updated and rendered when the component changes (RGAA 7.1).
report_rgaaRollup_note: One row per RGAA 4.1.2 criterion that a rule is linked to, grouping those rules. The links have not yet been reviewed by an RGAA auditor, and a passing row never means the criterion is conforme.
